scheduling.revalidation: Input/contract/code artifact changes invalidate consuming verification; coordinator reruns affected tests before advancing
scheduling.rollback: Revert exact owned commits in reverse dependency order; preserve audit/event history and verified backups
scheduling.conditional_lock_protocol: Before changing requirements-dev.lock, declare dependency work and acquire file:backend/requirements-dev.lock; keep it through independent verification and integration receipt. Verify the latest accepted lock SHA before writing, serialize append-only changes, and revalidate affected consumers on the merged lock. Other batches may continue on their pinned input snapshot without writing this path. A scheduler unable to enforce conditional locks must BLOCK the dependency write, not ignore the overlap.

plan_reload.hash_rule: Recompute SHA256 from the current on-disk plan files every cycle using the existing plan_sha256 representation. Cover both files; compare every entry if represented as per-file hashes. Never substitute mtime, a cached hash, or the persisted state's value for fresh reads.
plan_reload.compare_against: The last successfully loaded in-memory plan_sha256; persisted state is an audit hint, not the authority for the loaded version.
plan_reload.initial_load: If no in-memory plan is loaded, read and validate the current plan even when a persisted hash appears to match.
plan_reload.on_reload_success: Replace the validated in-memory plan and its hash together before any optional state write; reassess affected readiness and verification under existing revalidation rules.
plan_reload.on_state_write_failure: Retain the newly loaded in-memory plan and hash. Report the persistence error separately; do not block, roll back, or require write permission for reload. The next cycle still starts with fresh plan reads regardless of the previous persistence failure.
plan_reload.on_read_or_validation_failure: Do not advance the in-memory hash or dispatch from a stale/invalid plan. Report the read/validation failure separately and retry the read-only check next cycle; never treat a state-write failure as a plan-reload failure.
plan_reload.dispatch_boundary: Read-only reload does not authorize dispatch, state mutation or lock bypass. Operations requiring durable state or resource locks remain subject to the existing permission and scheduling gates, independently of reload.
acceptance_criteria: A plan hash change is observed at the next cycle start and the validated in-memory plan/hash update even when scheduler-state.json writes are denied.

With state persistence still failing, an unchanged current hash matches the loaded in-memory version and does not trigger repeated reloads solely because the persisted hash is stale; hashing still runs every cycle.
An invalid or inconsistent new plan does not advance the loaded hash or authorize stale-plan dispatch; a valid correction is retried at the next cycle without requiring state write permission.
After restart with stale persisted state and no in-memory plan, the current plan loads read-only; lack of state write permission does not suppress this initial load.

跨线判定四：验收标准与权限边界冲突时，先取得明确裁决；验收者不得自行删减标准、扩大权限或据此自动放行。

environment_policy.run_dir_resolution: Coordinator supplies a unique absolute RUN_DIR for each batch attempt and each independent verification. Expand placeholders before execution; commands.json must contain the resolved absolute commands, never unresolved templates.
environment_policy.isolation: Use only this run's venv with include-system-site-packages=false. No activation/PATH fallback, shared BATCH-02 venv, bare python/python3/py/pip/pytest/uvicorn, or system/user package installation. Python subprocesses use sys.executable.
environment_policy.provisioning: Coordinator provides the isolated venv before acceptance; bootstrap, if needed, uses a recorded absolute host interpreter outside batch acceptance, never a bare command. BATCH-01 needs only the standard library and venv-provided pip. BATCH-02 creates the first complete pinned lock; BATCH-03 onward requires the accepted lock in its input checkout.
environment_policy.run_dir_path_policy: RUN_DIR must be a short absolute path, recommended length <= 60 characters. The venv must be exactly one level below RUN_DIR at RUN_DIR/venv; implementation and independent verification must use the same venv depth convention. Do not enable system LongPaths or change global settings to bypass this policy.
environment_policy.longest_path_preflight: Before acceptance, print the longest file path under the venv. A path length >= 250 is an environment failure and the batch is BLOCKED until a shorter RUN_DIR is provisioned.
environment_policy.locked_install: BATCH-02 onward installs the complete direct/transitive lock with --no-deps into its own venv, then the backend with --no-deps --no-build-isolation. Build requirements must also be pinned; wheel builds use --no-isolation.
environment_policy.missing_dependency_preflight: BATCH-02 onward must import pytest and jsonschema before functional tests. pip check alone does not detect undeclared/missing test imports.
environment_policy.mandatory_delivery_result: Exit code 0 with complete stdout/stderr and interpreter/lock hashes; implementer, independent verifier and integration retest each run it in their own isolated environment. Never replace functional acceptance with pip check.

dependency_lock.applies_to: Every batch that introduces a third-party runtime, test or build dependency; independent verification remains read-only.
dependency_lock.creation: BATCH-02 initializes the complete lock only when absent; an existing lock, including BATCH-02 repair, is append-only. BATCH-01 normally has no third-party additions and must not invent dependencies.
dependency_lock.permitted_changes: Append missing distributions as exact name==version pins, including new transitive/build dependencies. Preserve all existing entries, versions, comments and line endings; an existing identical pin is NO_OP.
prohibited_changes: ranges, wildcards, floating URLs or unpinned dependencies
pip freeze replacing the file or whole-file formatting/EOL conversion
unlocked installs or dependency upgrades to hide failures
dependency_lock.write_condition: The batch genuinely requires a new dependency within its existing scope (or BATCH-02 initializes the lock) and holds the exclusive file lock. Without this condition, the listed lockfile path is read-only.
dependency_lock.evidence: In reports/batches/{batch_id}/environment.json record the absolute interpreter and Python/pip/package versions, dependency_lock_change=UNCHANGED or APPENDED/INITIALIZED, baseline and resulting lock SHA256, exact added packages/versions/reasons, append-only diff and install command/exit evidence. The changed lock must be in the same batch's reviewed commit; every batch also delivers pip-check.txt and commands.json.
dependency_lock.conflict_owner: B dependency owner plus coordinator; existing-pin changes or out-of-allowlist metadata edits require a separate bounded repair authorization. Do not quietly return to a shared environment or alter product contracts.
dependency_lock.rollback: Keep evidence, acquire the same file lock, and revert only the exact owned additions/commit after checking integrated consumers. Rebuild a fresh run venv from the accepted lock and retest; do not uninstall system packages or overwrite another batch's pins.

environment_policy.environment_preflight: Read and record core.autocrlf origin/value (unset is not a failure), relevant git ls-files --eol output and immutable approval hashes. No global git config or EOL normalization is authorized by this plan.
environment_policy.file_hash_verification: 凡对文件哈希做核验，一律以 git show <sha>:<path> 取提交内的 blob 字节为准计算，禁止使用默认工作副本文件；需要工作副本时必须使用受控 LF 检出。
environment_policy.failure_classification: Interpreter/venv, missing package, pin conflict and autocrlf/hash issues are ENVIRONMENT failures with evidence, not automatically product defects. Unresolved failures block handoff and affected dependants, never count as PASS.
environment_policy.verifier_evidence_location: reports/batches/{batch_id}/verification-evidence/; verifier writes only its own evidence/report, never implementation evidence or lockfile

plan_merge.scope: Planning synchronization and historical gate registration only; no code, dependencies, approvals, task state or DAG changes
plan_merge.dispatch_boundary: Independent V1-V5 PASS and new committed blob hashes must be recorded before clearing plan-drift blockers. No batch is started or unblocked by this merge; auto_start_next_batch remains false. Existing scheduler-index/packages must be revalidated against the new source before use.
